checked_semantics.analysis: PreAbstractSimplicialComplex stores exactly nonempty downward-closed faces. The finite ambient vertex type makes the face set finite; unused ambient vertices have coordinate zero. Realization is the union of the actual nonnegative unit-mass coordinate simplices with inherited finite-product topology. Empty-face convention has no geometric effect.

Punctured K v is x(v)<1, and coordinate_eq_one_iff/punctured_complement_homeomorph prove it is the literal deleted-vertex subspace whenever v is a vertex. The radial denominator is proved positive only on that domain; no extension across v is asserted. The radial homotopy fixes the actual deletion and remains in the original supporting face.

The B hypothesis is a HomotopyEquiv whose forward continuous map equals the literal subtype inclusion Punctured B v into Realization B. It is not merely an unspecified equivalence of those spaces. B<=K and {v} in B identify this with O intersection C into C in the common coordinate realization.

Evaluating the supplied inclusion homotopy inverse at v yields a path from a punctured point to v. A coordinate intermediate value forces an actual incident edge in B, then in K. Thus the link has a singleton face before any nonempty instance required by the suspension argument is introduced.

DeletionConeGluing proves an actual continuous surjection from the deletion disjoint-union the link cylinder; compact/Hausdorff hypotheses supply quotient topology, including product with the interval. GeneralSuspensionClassification constructs the forward collapse, reverse map and both homotopies explicitly from a deletion contraction. The final original_suspension_classification invokes only the original subcomplex, vertex, contractible puncture and actual-inclusion hypotheses.

For every finite L with an actual vertex, two distinct new Sum Bool V poles form two genuine cones. B is the closed edge from one pole to a chosen base vertex. The puncture contracts to the opposite cone, and the specified punctured-B inclusion is the forward map of the proved equivalence. A bijective continuous map from the ordinary quotient suspension to the finite two-cone realization gives the actual homeomorphism, establishing every stated type.

pole_open sets are actual strict-coordinate-open subsets; exclusivity of pole coordinates proves the union is the whole two-cone realization. Each is a genuine punctured contractible cone model. Positive total base mass on their intersection permits normalized-base projection; its actual equator inclusion and explicit linear homotopy prove intersection homotopy equivalent to L.

UsedVertex filters singleton faces. usedComplex does not add singleton faces to the original vertex type. Coordinate restriction and zero extension are inverse homeomorphisms. coordinateCarrier_iff_support and the inspected TauCeti finite realization map give the homeomorphism to the true weak realization; its classical CW structure is built on actual face cells.

The two-open wrapper uses reduced integral singular homology, whose degree-zero object is inspected to be the kernel of H0 augmentation. Nonemptiness and zero reduced H0 yield path connected intersection; actual van Kampen yields simply connected union. Actual Mayer-Vietoris supplies positive homology vanishing, Hurewicz removes higher homotopy, and Whitehead applies with the proved CW type. No acyclic=>contractible shortcut for arbitrary spaces occurs.

The ordered chain source is the free Z module on faces with n+1 vertices, with the signed deleted-vertex boundary. The cellular comparison rescales by units and is a chain isomorphism. The new proof checks its degree-zero scale is 1 and each zero-cell augmentation is 1; the resulting quasi-isomorphism criterion is equivalent to all reduced integral singular homology vanishing, including degree zero. No rationalization or rank-only test occurs.

CoordinateReindex uses a genuine equivalence V ~= Fin(card V), maps the precise face set by inverse image, and proves inverse continuous permutations of coordinates. Thus OriginalCriterion retains V:Type* rather than silently restricting the original finite complexes to the external Type0 homology API.

original_contractible_iff_finiteOrderedAcyclic has the original K/B/v, B<=K, actual vertex, contractible deleted-point representation, and actual punctured-B inclusion equivalence hypotheses. Link nonemptiness is derived. The result equates actual realization contractibility to the true integer ordered augmentation QuasiIso of the used finite link, using previously proved suspension and singular-homology bridges.

chainCoordinates is a proved Z-linear equivalence between finite face-indexed chains and integer coordinate vectors. boundaryMatrix is LinearMap.toMatrix of the conjugated actual boundary, with proved mulVec equality. Each face column entry is (-1)^j at the actual j-th deleted vertex and zero off codimension-one subfaces. The augmentation row is the finite all-ones sum. Both zero-degree and positive-degree matrix kernel=image conditions are proved equivalent to their actual chain counterparts.

FiniteAugmentedExact includes the augmentation kernel and a bounded Fin(card V) family of all integer cycle-boundary conditions. Any face in degree n>=card V would require n+1 vertices, so its chain group is zero. This proves equivalence to every positive degree, retaining top homology. Integer quantifiers and images preserve torsion; the empty base case is not accidentally admitted because the final geometric endpoint first derives an actual link vertex.

FiniteLocalCriterion combines the true integer-matrix exactness iff with the actual topological contractibility iff. Its final theorem retains K, B, v, subcomplex inclusion, actual distinguished vertex, actual punctured contractibility and specified inclusion homotopy equivalence, with V:Type*. It derives the link vertex rather than assuming it. vertex_link_eq_of_incident_faces and finiteLocalMatrixCriterion_eq_of_incident_faces prove changing non-v-incident simplices cannot change the test.
